tokens.name: system-purple

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Color.accentColor. Active command slot fill (at opacity-active), console toggle when shown. Follows the user's accent setting; blue is the macOS default. macOS system color, not defined in the repo: Apple reference value, which can shift between OS releases.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: .primary. Names and values on window-background and control-background. macOS system color, not defined in the repo: Apple reference value, which can shift between OS releases.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: .secondary. Kind badges, IDs, parameter summaries, status bar text. In light mode about 3.9:1 on window-background, under 4.5:1; kept as the OS defines it. macOS system color, not defined in the repo: Apple reference value, which can shift between OS releases.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: .tertiary. Decorative separators only, such as the bullet between ID and summary in a Navigator row. Also the fill behind the keyboard shortcut chip in Settings. Not for text that carries meaning. macOS system color, not defined in the repo: Apple reference value, which can shift between OS releases.

tokens.name: separator

tokens.name: window-background
